name: L bracket, two holes
description: An L-shaped bracket made of two flat legs of equal thickness meeting at a right angle at the origin corner. The horizontal leg lies along +X on the XY plane. The vertical leg rises along +Z from the same corner. Both legs are the same width in Y. One hole passes vertically through the horizontal leg near its free end; a second hole passes horizontally (along X) through the vertical leg near its top.
notes: Build it as two boxes with centered=False sharing the corner at (0,0,0), then union them - the shared corner block must not be counted twice. Horizontal leg occupies x 0..3.0, y 0..1.5, z 0..0.25. Vertical leg occupies x 0..0.25, y 0..1.5, z 0..2.0. Vertical hole centre at (2.000, 0.750); horizontal hole centre at y=0.750, z=1.500 drilled along X.
